description:
Track time against threads, billable and unbillable, stored one file per thread.

Subcommands:
  log THREAD DESCRIPTION... [-m MINUTES] [-r RATE] [-c CURRENCY] [-d YYYY-MM-DD] [-t HH:MM] [--all] — append an entry (INTERACTIVE if THREAD is omitted)
  list [THREAD] [--since YYYY-MM-DD] [--until YYYY-MM-DD] [--json] — list entries
  report [--thread T] [--since YYYY-MM-DD] [--until YYYY-MM-DD] [--json] — totals by thread and currency, unbilled time totalled separately
  show ID [--json] — show one entry
  edit ID [--description TEXT] [-m MINUTES] [-r RATE] [-c CURRENCY] [-d DATE] [-t TIME] — change fields of an entry
  rm ID [-y] — delete an entry (DESTRUCTIVE)

Flags:
  log: -m duration in minutes, default 60; -r hourly rate, 0 means unbillable; -c 3-letter ISO currency, defaults to the thread's, and without either the entry is recorded as unbilled; -d date, default today; -t time HH:MM, default now; --all applies to interactive mode only.
  list: --since and --until are inclusive YYYY-MM-DD; --json JSON output.
  report: --thread, --since, --until, --json.
  edit: --description new description; -m, -r, -c, -d, -t as for log.
  rm: -y skip confirmation.

Examples:
  ["log", "Projects/SGB", "Drafted the integration spec", "-m", "90"]
  ["list", "Projects/SGB", "--since", "2026-08-01", "--json"]
  ["report", "--since", "2026-08-01", "--json"]
  ["edit", "a1b2c3d4", "-m", "45"]

Notes:
  Never call `log` without THREAD — it drops into interactive capture and reads stdin.
  THREAD is a thread name, 'Kind/Name', or wikilink, and must resolve to an existing thread file.
  DESCRIPTION is variadic: pass the whole description as one array element to keep it intact.
  Asking for a rate with no currency is refused; a thread with no currency records rate 0 and no currency, and its time totals under an unbilled row that `payments statement` ignores.
  ID is the 8-hex entry id, shared as one namespace with payments ids.
